2) Initial redline review — Kimberly to post summary + high-priority asks by Thu 17th

- Liability & cap language (we’ll propose a commercial cap tied to fees)
- Confidentiality / IP carveouts for product telemetry and improvements
- Data residency and security obligations (SOC 2 + subprocessor list)
- Audit & logging / eDiscovery scope (we usually narrow audit windows)
- Indemnities and limitation of remedies (keep narrow and mutual where possible)

Please upload your tracked Word redlines to the secure folder: https://redwood-internal.drive/secure/stellaraq-evidence (or send me the file directly). If you’re sending a single redline PDF that’s fine but tracked changes accelerates our mapping.

I’ve created an initial tracker for changes and will drop a short summary (high/medium/low priority) by Thu 17th EOD. If there are any non-standard exhibits (e.g., Exhibit D for hosting) please flag them in the tracker.

Attachment note: I don’t yet have the SOC 2 report in hand — Taylor, if your security team can share the report or a SysTrust attestation link that would speed the review.
